scope.summary: Implement firmness-channel-driven soft-tissue parameters (spec 13.20; OBR-001 physics link): natural-soft vs implant-rigid motion derived mechanically from the breast/glute firmness channels via documented mapping curves onto XPBD compliance, damping, and volume-constraint stiffness - implant-firm tissue must move differently than natural-soft.
acceptance_criteria: Documented mechanical mapping from firmness channel value to XPBD params (compliance, damping, volume-constraint stiffness): natural-soft yields low stiffness and pronounced secondary motion; implant-firm yields high stiffness and minimal lag - the bolt-on look moves like a bolt-on.
Same-drop contrast test: an identical body drop at firmness 0 vs firmness 1 produces measurably different settle trajectories (amplitude and settle-time deltas asserted).
The mapping reads channel values through explicit inspectable link edges (MT-496 pattern) and is disable-able for manual parameter override - no hidden coupling.
Parameters re-derive automatically on any firmness/volume channel change without re-authoring cages.
scope.risk_if_missed: If firmness does not mechanically change motion, implant-firm and natural-soft breasts jiggle identically and OBR-001's firmness axis becomes cosmetic-only; hardcoded hidden params would additionally violate the explicit-link decouple law.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit soft tissue and physical response

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Keep one solver world but separate tissue constitutive models, require two-way contact for final quality, and reuse the new checkpoint/contact/receipt gates.
Reconcile preview cages with final nonlinear tissue, inversion barriers, full shared contacts, accepted checkpoints, and reference motion scenes.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
